notes: v1.52: Visual Pixel Guard region picker. New '📐 Pick Region on Screen' button in the Guard tab — click it, then drag a rectangle around the area to monitor (e.g. the minimap label 'The Raft'). Rectangle auto-converts to X/Y/W/H percentages of the target window. Bonus '⬜ Use Full Window' button. Events/groups persist across update as always.
